meta.title: Build Your Tint, See Your Shade | BC Glass & Tint
meta.description: Pick your vehicle and windows and see each shade on screen, with Nevada's tint rule shown on every window. Your build gets a short code to share with the shop.
meta.image_alt: Build Your Tint tool from BC Glass and Tint, Boulder City, NV

hero.heading: Build your tint. See the price.
hero.heading_without_prices: Build your tint. See it on screen.
hero.heading_rule: Use heading when anyAutoPrice(pricing, mode) in lib/pricing.js is true; otherwise heading_without_prices.
hero.intro: Pick your vehicle and the windows you want. Every window shows what Nevada allows.

vehicle.heading: Your vehicle
vehicle.model_hint: Goes with your request so the shop knows the vehicle. Never required.

examples.label: Pickup, front doors to match the back

windows.intro: Tap a window on the car or below, then pick a shade.
windows.vlt_note: Shades are VLT, the percent of light the film lets through.

front.label: Front doors
front.legal: Front doors stop at Nevada's line: at least 35 percent of light, with a 7 percent tolerance, nonreflective. NRS 484D.440.

rear.label: Rear doors
rear.legal: No darkness limit when both outside mirrors show at least 200 feet behind you. NRS 484D.440.

back.label: Back glass
back.legal: No darkness limit when both outside mirrors show at least 200 feet behind you. NRS 484D.440.

windows.strip_legal: Windshield film: the top strip only, never red or amber. NRS 484D.440.

stage.caption: Illustration, not a photo of your vehicle.
stage.note: Shades on screen match each film's VLT as closely as a screen can. Your screen and your factory glass change the real look. Ask to see the film on your glass at the shop.

result.heading: Your build
result.price_note: Starting price for this build. The exact price is confirmed before anything is booked.
result.fallback_note: The shop confirms your exact price before anything is booked.
result.code_hint: It sums up your vehicle and every window you picked, in one line.
result.fronts_vs_full: Rear doors and back glass for {article} add {rear}. Full sides and back is {full}.
result.upgrade_benefit: Shades the back seat too, at the same shade as your front doors.
result.upgrade_button: Add the rear doors and back glass
result.upgrade_button_price: Add the rear doors and back glass, {rear}
result.upgrade_done: Rear doors and back glass added at your front door shade.
result.ask_note: These never change the total. They go with your build so the shop sees them.
result.request_note: Nothing is booked until the shop confirms.
result.warranty: Lifetime manufacturer warranty on window film.
result.resume_text: You have a build from your last visit.

handoff.saved_note: Your saved build {code} is filled in below.
handoff.removed: Build removed from this request. It is still saved on Build Your Tint.

noscript.heading: What Nevada allows on each window
noscript.intro: This tool needs JavaScript to draw your build. Here are the rules it shows, and the full price list is one tap away.

legal_footer: Illustration only. Rules can change; check the current statute. This is not legal advice. NRS 484D.440.
